formulas.ascii: h_i = t_i (E - E_i) / (E T), H = sum_i h_i. E = sum_m P_m ln(1 / P_m) is the diversity of all residents, E_i the same for tract i, t_i its population, T the total. Undefined (NaN) when E = 0 or the total is 0.
